product.name: weft
product.eyebrow: Specification first · no control host or node binary yet
promise: A compute cloud you deploy yourself.
product.lede: weft is a compute cloud a team runs on its own machines: one control plane and any number of worker nodes that run confined workloads for tenants and their nested accounts. Today it is an ESS specification of that cloud, 23 domains and 4 components, explored in memory by cloudspec-sim, and a gate that holds it. The control host and the node agent are planned.
product.description: weft is a compute cloud you deploy yourself, specified first in ESS: the specification, the gate and simulation with cloudspec-sim exist today; the control host and the node agent are planned.

sections.title: From a specification to a running cloud.
sections.lede: Every part of weft is an ESS document first, so the cloud can be checked and simulated before any of it runs.

steps.label: ess/
steps.title: Specify
steps.description: 23 domains in 10 layers, 4 components and their reconciliation bindings, validated by ess.

steps.label: cloudspec-sim
steps.title: Explore
steps.description: Random command sequences and experiments on the interpreted model, with system invariants checked after each step.

steps.label: task check
steps.title: Gate
steps.description: Validation, the layer rule, the stamped-time rule, the docs claims and the tests on every change.

steps.label: planned

sections.title: One control plane, many nodes, isolation by default.
sections.lede: Decided means specified in ESS and not built yet. No egress, no secrets and no traffic between components unless declared and allowed.

items.title: Tenants and nested accounts
items.description: Accounts nest to any depth; quotas are checked at every level.

items.title: Formations
items.description: The deployable unit: components, the links between them and the border to the outside.

items.title: Workloads of many kinds
items.description: Images, VMs, models, code, ESS systems and agents, each with a shape and claims.

items.title: Claims on resources
items.description: GPUs, disks, addresses and secrets through one generic resource model.

items.title: Nodes and clusters
items.description: Worker nodes dial out to the control plane; tenants get clusters of their own.

items.title: cloudspec-sim
